name: Martha J. Wright
occupation: Experience in the medical field, criminal justice, church work, and, as of a June 2022 Sheridan Press announcement, the YMCA
education: Cheyenne East High School (The Sheridan Press, June 3, 2022)
background: Martha J. Wright of Sheridan ran as a Democrat for House District 29 in 2022 and 2024, losing both general elections. In 2024 she reached the general-election ballot as a Democratic primary write-in (Ballotpedia); the official general result on the WyoVote Profile is 1,325 votes (30.6%).

The Sheridan Press reported on June 3, 2022, when she declared her first candidacy, that she was born in Casper, raised in Cheyenne, and graduated from Cheyenne East High School, and that her life and work had taken her out of state and back to Wyoming. The article said her experience had included work in the medical field, criminal justice, her church, and, at the time of that announcement, the YMCA, and that she described her life as one of service.
